name: btc-usd-daily-breakout-v1
rationale: Test whether a fixed price-channel entry and exit captures persistent BTC price moves after costs over a genuinely future interval. This is a new rule within the already-explored trend-following family, not an independent discovery or a replication of the cited futures research. The 20/10-day windows are design choices fixed without testing alternatives. The rejected SMA evidence does not support this hypothesis; no historical profitability is claimed.
